title: A barrier before the battle
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Intact skin is a physical barrier that helps limit pathogen entry. It does not make infection impossible, and breaks or other routes can let pathogens enter.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: How does intact skin contribute to innate defense against many pathogens? Intact skin is a physical barrier that helps limit pathogen entry. It does not make infection impossible, and breaks or other routes can let pathogens enter.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: Which innate barrier helps block entry of many pathogens? Intact skin helps limit pathogen entry.

recall.question: Which innate barrier helps block entry of many pathogens?
recall.why: Intact skin helps limit pathogen entry.
